hypothesis: Early same-session AMD/NVDA/SMH participation may distinguish semiconductor-wide strength from SOXX/SOXL ETF-only opening movement before the original Stage1 09:46 allocation decision; no sign or economic efficacy is tested in this source phase.
receiver: Frozen complete original Stage1 09:46 allocation target and its later action/risk/recovery chain; SOXX is final benchmark. A later separately frozen information screen would test H5 SOXL-minus-SOXX selection, not 10:32 recovery value.

feature.name: opening_15m_semiconductor_peer_positive_fraction_3
feature.formula: For each peer require exactly the three completed price-valid five-minute bars. Compute log(close_09:45/open_09:35)>0 and take the fraction positive among the fixed three; zero return counts nonpositive. No smoothing or ETF weighting.
feature.assumed_available_at: 09:45 America/New_York at completion of the last right-labelled bar, under the source's bar clock convention; actual first receipt remains unverified
feature.receiver_decision_at: 09:46 America/New_York same trade date; source first receipt and finality historically unqualified

quality: Native Qlib D.calendar/D.features and DatasetH/Recorder. Strict 3x3 complete window, source identity, NAS receipt and scoped restore. No market outcome labels. Existing Stage1 original39 includes SOXX/SOXL current marks and historical breadth, not same-session three-peer opening breadth; future novelty must still be checked in training only.
stop: Any source/NAS identity, timing, coverage, Qlib or NAS readback failure stops. A pass only permits a separately frozen information test and does not establish first-public PIT, a 0bp account or SOXX success.
